subject: Sprint Zero: Onramp credentials, IP allowlist & VPC peering - CloudMed MAP
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@cloudmed.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint Zero: Onramp credentials, IP allowlist & VPC peering - CloudMed MAP

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our mutual action plan, I pulled together the Sprint Zero checklist so we can get your eval environment provisioned end-to-end. Attached is a draft MAP that covers the key infra steps. High level timeline I propose: 

- API key provisioning (dev/test keys): target by Thu 2026-09-09
- Redwood org setup (invite dev users, assign roles): Fri 2026-09-10
- IP allowlist for test endpoints (CIDR blocks): Mon 2026-09-11
- VPC peering request + routing validation: request by Mon 2026-09-11, target peering window Wed 2026-09-14

Can you confirm:
1) who on your SRE/network team we should coordinate the peering details with (name + email)?
2) any org-level compliance constraints (e.g., disallowed ports) we should pre-check?

I've attached: CloudMed_MAP_Sprint0_v1.pdf (MAP draft) and redwood_network_requirements.xlsx (network checklist). Also including the standard VPC peer template (vpc-peer-template.txt) for your network team to review.

Proposed preflight call: Wed 2026-09-08 10:00 PT — 30 minutes. If that works I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda: quick intro, API key handoff, required CIDRs, and peering SLAs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into the environment.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-9210

Attachments: CloudMed_MAP_Sprint0_v1.pdf (MAP draft), redwood_network_requirements.xlsx (network checklist), vpc-peer-template.txt
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@cloudmed.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@cloudmed.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Sprint Zero: Onramp credentials, IP allowlist & VPC peering - CloudMed MAP

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAP. We're happy to move forward on the timeline you proposed. Quick answers: 

1) SRE point-of-contact: Carlos Mendez (carlos.m@cloudmed.io). He'll own peering config and the firewall change window.
2) Compliance flags: we avoid inbound SSH to prod ranges but for the eval environment the usual ports (80/443 and health-check ports) are OK — Carlos will confirm exact port whitelist in the call.

Carlos: looping you in so you have context. We can do the preflight call Wed 2026-09-08 10:00 PT.

Also, we have an internal network diagram that we'll bring to the call (not attached here). If you need our ASN or more specific CIDRs ahead of time, we can share.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Ops | CloudMed
elena@cloudmed.io | +1 (617) 555-0188

Elena / Carlos —

Thanks for confirming. Call invite sent for Wed 2026-09-08 10:00 PT (30 min). Agenda: 1) Introductions & roles, 2) API key handoff process (we'll provision dev/test keys in the console and send via secure link), 3) CIDRs & port whitelist (CloudMed to confirm), 4) VPC peering process & proposed test plan.

Next steps summary (owner / target):
- Redwood: provision dev/test API keys and create CloudMed dev org (Jonas) — target 2026-09-09
- CloudMed: confirm SRE contact and provide CIDRs + ASN (Elena/Carlos) — target 2026-09-09
- Redwood Eng: prepare peering runbook & test tokens (Marcus) — target 2026-09-11
- Both: schedule peering window (tentatively Wed 2026-09-14 afternoon PT) and run connectivity test (both sides)

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890), engineering ticket (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-9123). Attached final MAP draft and network checklist.

I'll follow up after the preflight with updated MAP that includes runbook steps and a short acceptance checklist.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — talk soon.

— Jonas
